title: E2E Integration Testing (5 Representative Parts)
description: End-to-end integration testing with 5 representative manufacturing parts: prismatic bracket (3-axis), 5-axis impeller (blade/hub/shroud), mill-turn shaft (OD/ID/threading), grinding case (surface/cylindrical/creep), wire EDM die (taper/multi-axis/bi-material). Each part exercises the full pipeline from material lookup through PPP-optimized G-code output.

sessions.title: E2E Parts 1-3: Prismatic + Impeller + Mill-Turn

smart_config.role: Senior CNC Programmer + Integration Test Engineer

sessions.intent: Three representative parts produce correct G-code through the full hyperMILL-PRISM pipeline. A machinist would load the output and run the first part with confidence.

units.title: E2E Part 1: Prismatic bracket (3-axis)
units.description: Material: 7075-T6. Operations: face mill, pocket, drill holes, tap M8, chamfer edges. Verify: material lookup → tool selection → S/F calc → PPP → G-code with correct Fanuc dialect. All S/F within 5% of handbook values.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Full pipeline produces valid Fanuc G-code
Tool selection matches optimal for each operation
Machinist would run this part on first attempt

units.title: E2E Part 2: 5-axis impeller (blade/hub/shroud)
units.description: Material: Inconel 718. Operations: rough impeller channel, semi-finish blade, finish hub, finish shroud, deburr edges. Verify: 5-axis multi-axis engine → strategy selection → SLD-safe RPM → PPP with TRAORI → Siemens 840D G-code.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Surface integrity check passes (no white layer)

units.title: E2E Part 3: Mill-turn shaft (OD/ID/threading)
units.description: Material: 4140 steel. Operations: face, OD rough, OD finish, bore ID, groove, thread M24×2. Verify: turning pipeline → CSS mode → tool nose comp → G76 threading → Mazak dialect.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: G96 CSS mode with S_max clamp
Bar feeder M-codes present if configured

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ 3/3 parts produce valid G-code | ✓ S/F within spec | ✓ Correct dialects | ✓ Machinist acceptance | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: E2E Parts 4-5: Grinding + Wire EDM + Regression Suite
sessions.intent: All 5 E2E parts pass. Regression suite prevents future breakage. hyperMILL-PRISM pipeline is production-validated.

units.title: E2E Part 4+5: Grinding case + Wire EDM die
units.description: Part 4: D2 steel grinding (surface + cylindrical + creep feed). Part 5: Wire EDM die (SKD11, taper cut, 4-axis, bi-material zone). Verify: grinding wheel selection, dressing cycle, burn risk check. EDM: wire tension, flush pressure, taper UV compensation.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Grinding: wheel selection correct for D2
Grinding: burn risk check fires for aggressive params

units.title: E2E regression suite + validation action + skill
units.description: Build regression test suite that runs all 5 E2E parts as a single test command. Build cam:hypermill_e2e_validate action and /hypermill-validate-part skill. Create golden output snapshots for regression detection.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: 5/5 E2E tests in single regression suite

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ 5/5 E2E parts pass | ✓ Regression suite green | ✓ Golden snapshots saved | ✓ Action + skill created | ✓ tsc 0 errors | omega_floor >= 0.95 | SVI delta: +8%
